reactions.description: When Silas is hit by an attack, he can activate a Sura-Khai relic on his belt. He teleports up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space he can see, leaving a 10-foot-radius cloud of thick grey fog in the space he left. The fog lasts until the end of his next turn, heavily obscuring the area. The triggering attack misses Silas.

traits.name: Ashen Acclimation
traits.description: Vex can see perfectly through heavy fog, smoke, and ash storms up to a distance of 120 feet.

traits.name: Tactical Monocle
traits.description: Vex's Sura-Khai ocular eyepiece analyzes weaknesses. Vex's weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. Additionally, his ranged attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover.

traits.name: Brander's Aura
traits.description: Whenever an unbranded creature starts its turn within 10 feet of Vex, the heat radiating from his heavy basalt gauntlet forces them to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) fire damage on a failed save.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Vex makes two attacks: one with his Jagged Dredge Blade and one with his Heavy Brander Gauntlet.

actions.name: Jagged Dredge Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Brander Gauntlet
actions.description: Melee Relic Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is Grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target takes 9 (2d8) fire damage at the start of each of its turns, and Vex cannot use the gauntlet to attack another target.

actions.name: Dull Crimson Vent (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Vex releases a blast of superheated volcanic gas from his gauntlet in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

reactions.name: Tactical Parry
reactions.description: Vex adds 3 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Vex must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Ametal Composition
traits.description: The Loom-Guard is made of treated stone and verdigris gold. It ignores any effects that specifically target metal armor or weapons.

traits.name: Solid-Light Anchor
traits.description: The Loom-Guard cannot be moved or knocked prone against its will by any effect of 1st level or lower.

actions.name: Verdigris Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Loom-Net (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. Hit: The target is Restrained by a net of woven ghostly cyan light (escape DC 12). While restrained, the target takes 3 (1d6) force damage at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Ashen Acclimation
traits.description: The Enforcer ignores all visibility penalties caused by heavy fog, ash storms, or darkness up to a distance of 120 feet.

traits.name: Phalanx Bulwark
traits.description: While the Enforcer is within 5 feet of an ally carrying a shield, both the Enforcer and the ally have advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone or pushed, and they gain a +1 bonus to their AC.

traits.name: Cyan Search-Lantern (Relic)
traits.description: Mounted to the Enforcer's shoulder is a Sura-Khai lens that projects a 30-foot cone of intense Ghostly Cyan light. This light cuts through magical and nonmagical fog, and any invisible creatures or objects caught in the cone are outlined in light and lose their invisibility.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Enforcer makes two melee attacks: one with its Basalt Mace and one with its Shield Bash. Alternatively, it can make two ranged attacks with its Heavy Crossbow.

actions.name: Basalt Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked Prone.

actions.name: Harpoon-Crossbow
actions.description: (Recharge 5-6): Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8) piercing damage, and a barbed steel harpoon lodges in the target. The target is Grappled (escape DC 14) by the wire cable. While a creature is grappled this way, the Enforcer can use a bonus action to reel the cable, pulling the target up to 15 feet closer to them.

reactions.name: Interposing Shield
reactions.description: When an enemy makes a melee attack against an ally within 5 feet of the Enforcer, the Enforcer can use its reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

GUILD ENFORCER.description:
They Abuse the Fog: Because of Ashen Acclimation, these guards can see up to 120 feet, while your players are restricted to 15 yards (45 feet) [8]. The guards will stand safely in the deep fog, using their Harpoon-Crossbows to spear a player (like Rainlyn or Osric) and drag them backward into the darkness before the party even realizes where the attack is coming from.
Orderly Phalanx: In melee, the guards form a tight wall. They stand side-by-side to trigger their Phalanx Bulwark, raising their AC to 19 and covering each other with Interposing Shield reactions. They don't fight to kill immediately; they use Shield Bash to knock players prone, then use their weapons to keep them pinned.
Alarm Whistles: If a fight breaks out, the first thing one of the guards will do on their turn is blow a Sura-Khai resonance whistle. The high-pitched shriek vibrates through the stones of Vellum's Port, calling 1d4 additional Enforcers to the scene every 2 rounds. This teaches the players that fighting the law is a battle of attrition they cannot win.
"Unlike standard fantasy guards who act as bumbling town watchmen, these enforcers are heavily disciplined, physically imposing, and specifically equipped with Sura-Khai relic technology to hunt down escaped "stock" and contain the Blight."

traits.name: Ashen Acclimation
traits.description: The Warden can see perfectly through heavy fog and darkness.

traits.name: Mycelial Regeneration
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the Warden regains 5 hit points if it is in contact with the stone floor. If it takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Spore Cloud
traits.description: A cloud of toxic grey spores surrounds the Warden in a 10-foot radius. Any non-plant creature that enters or starts its turn in the cloud must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be Poisoned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Warden makes two melee attacks with its Spindle-Spear.

actions.name: Spindle-Spear
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

actions.name: Void-Howl
actions.description: (Recharge 5-6). The Warden unleashes a soundless, psychic wave of agony. Each non-undead creature within 30 feet of the Warden must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage and is Frightened of the Warden for 1 minute. On a success, the creature takes half damage and isn't frightened.

actions.name: Loom-Needle
actions.description: Ranged Relic Attack: +5 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) force damage. If the target is flying, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or have its flying speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn, causing it to fall.

legendary_actions.name: Skitter
legendary_actions.description: The Warden moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks

legendary_actions.name: Spindle Strike
legendary_actions.description: The Warden makes one Spindle-Spear attack or one Loom-Needle attack.

legendary_actions.name: Puff-Ball
legendary_actions.description: The Warden violently detonates a fungal sac on its shoulder. A burst of acidic rot shoots out. One creature within 15 feet of the Warden must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

reactions.name: Void-Step
reactions.description: (3/Day): When a creature moves within 5 feet of the Warden, the Warden can use its reaction to teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. In the space it leaves behind, a puff of blinding grey ash erupts. The triggering creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be Blinded until the end of its next turn

lair_actions.name: THE RELIC VAULT
lair_actions.description:
[On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the Warden can take a lair action to cause one of the following magical effects; the Warden can’t use the same effect two rounds in a row.]

Light-Grid Weft: The glowing Sura-Khai plaques on the wall surge with power. Two 5-foot-wide, 30-foot-long lines of ghostly cyan light erupt across the room. Any creature caught in these lines must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

Loom-Grind: The giant, brass gears hanging from the ceiling grind violently. Debris and petrified stone fall from the roof. Up to two creatures must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be pinned under the rubble, taking 5 (1d10) bludgeoning damage and being Grappled (escape DC 13).

The Great Silence: The air in the vault becomes completely, unnaturally void of sound. No sound can be made, and verbal communication is impossible within the vault until initiative count 20 of the next round. This heavily restricts verbal (V) spellcasting for players for 1 round.

THE HOLLOW WARDEN.description:
LEGENDARY ACTIONS
The Warden can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Warden regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

traits.name: Ametal Composition
traits.description: The Loom-Weaver is composed of treated stone and brass silicates. It ignores any effects that specifically target metal armor or weapons.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The Loom-Weaver can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Silent Loom
traits.description: The Loom-Weaver moves in absolute silence. It has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while moving along stone surfaces.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Loom-Weaver makes two Spindle Strikes.

actions.name: Spindle Strike
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Relic Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) force damage.

actions.name: Weft-Tether
actions.description:
(Recharge 5-6): The Loom-Weaver fires a barbed spool of ghostly cyan solid-light thread at a creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw.
On a failure: The target is tethered to a solid-light anchor on the nearest surface. A tethered creature cannot move more than 20 feet away from the anchor.
Breaking the Tether: A tethered creature can use its action to make a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check, snapping the thread on a success. Alternatively, another creature can use its action to slash the thread with a magical weapon, destroying it. If a creature forcibly breaks the tether, the feedback of solid-light energy deals 7 (2d6) force damage to the tethered creature.

traits.name: Water Bound
traits.description: The serpent has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while fully submerged in the black water.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the creature is Restrained, and the serpent can't constrict another target.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The warden can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The warden makes two attacks with its Spectral Blade.

actions.name: Spectral Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

traits.name: Brittle Joints
traits.description: Whenever the Sentinel takes bludgeoning damage from a heavy weapon or falling debris, its speed is reduced by 5 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Heavy Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Earth-Shake
actions.description: (Recharge 5-6). The Sentinel slams its fists into the stone floor. Each creature within 10 feet of the Sentinel must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked Prone.

traits.name: Ashen Acclimation
traits.description: The wraith ignores all visibility penalties caused by heavy fog, ash storms, or darkness up to a distance of 120 feet.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The wraith can move through other creatures and solid objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the wraith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wraith makes two attacks: one with its Spectral Spindle-Blade and one with its Stagnant Touch.

actions.name: Spectral Spindle-Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) cold damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Stagnant Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target's movement speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the wraith's next turn.

actions.name: Weft-Tether
actions.description: (Recharge 5-6): The wraith shoots a cord of spectral, ghostly cyan light at a creature within 30 feet [1, 2]. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be Restrained by the threads of light until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Displacement Flicker
reactions.description: (2/Day): When the wraith takes damage, it can use its reaction to magically flicker out of phase, teleporting up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

resistances: Necrotic, Cold; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Ashen Camouflage
traits.description: The Creeper has advantage on Stealth checks made to hide in the fog or ash storms [8]. While it remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a massive, scorched tree or a colossal, rotting fungal growth

traits.name: Vibration Sense
traits.description: The Creeper is deaf and blind, but it ignores the "Silence Rule" penalty [1]. It can detect the exact location of any creature touching the ground within 120 feet, provided the creature has moved or made a sound in the last round

traits.name: Blighted Canopy (Aura)
traits.description: Sickly, decaying spores constantly drift from the massive fungal caps on the Creeper's shoulders [8]. Any non-fungal creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the Creeper must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) necrotic damage as their flesh begins to rot

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The Creeper deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Creeper makes three attacks: one with its Bite and two with its Withered Claws. If both Claw attacks hit a Large or smaller creature, the target is Grappled (escape DC 17)

actions.name: Withered Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage

actions.name: Blight-Gorged Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage [1, 2]. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or contract the Necrotic Blight (as detailed in your campaign rules)

actions.name: Drag into the Haze
actions.description: As a bonus action, the Creeper can move at its full speed while dragging a grappled creature [1]. It specifically attempts to drag the creature deep into the fog, far beyond the visibility limits of its allies

actions.name: The Vibrating Hum
actions.description: (Recharge 5-6): The Creeper emits a bone-shattering, low-frequency hum [1]. All non-fungal creatures within 30 feet must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw [1]. On a failure, a creature takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and is Frightened for 1 minute [1]. While Frightened this way, a creature's speed is 0 [1]. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and is not Frightened.

reactions.name: Spore Detonation
reactions.description: When hit by a melee attack, the Creeper can violently burst a pressurized spore sac. The attacker must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be Blinded by thick, grey ash until the end of its next turn

traits.name: Fungal Regeneration
traits.description: Regains 10 hp/round unless it took fire damage.

traits.name: Earthbound Meld
traits.description: While on stone/mud can use a bonus action to gain resistances to bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Root of the Weaver
traits.description: Can use it's bioluminescent light to cast entangle once per day.

actions.name: Multi-attack
actions.description: Makes two Bone-Stone Slam attacks and one Root Slam.

actions.name: Bone Stone Slam
actions.description: +9 to hit, reach 10ft, one target. Hit: 15 (2d8+6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Root Slam
actions.description: +9 to hit, reach 15ft, one target. Hit: 19 (3d8+6) bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked prone (DC 16 STR save).

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The ashen bulwark deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.description: If the bulwark moves at least 20ft. straight towards a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 17 strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone the bulwark can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Living Landmark
traits.description: Due to it's immense size and the fungal shelf growths on its back, it can provide full cover to up to two medium creatures standing directly behind or underneath it.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee weapon attack: +9 to hit, reach 10ft, one target. Hit: 28 (4d10+6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: Melee weapon attack: +9 to hit, reach 5ft, two targets (if standing directly in front of the creature). Hit: 22 (3d10+6) bludgeoning damage. If the target(s) are prone, Hit: Hit: 27 (4d10+6)  bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Fungal Exhaust
actions.description: (Recharge 6) The bulwark forcefully expels a cloud of spores from the vents in its back. Each creature within 15 feet of the bulwark must make a DC 16 CON saving throw. On a failure the creature takes 21 (6d6) necrotic damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, the creature takes half damage and is not poisoned.

traits.name: Ashen Acclimation
traits.description: Ignores all visibility penalties caused by heavy fog, ash storms, or darkness up to a distance of 120 feet.

traits.name: Forge-Hardened Rage
traits.description: (3/Day): As a bonus action, Kroeger can enter a violent combat trance that lasts for 1 minute. While raging, he gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and deals an extra 3 damage on melee weapon attacks (included in attacks below)

traits.name: Reckless Assault
traits.description: At the start of his turn, Kroeger can choose to attack recklessly. Doing so gives him advantage on melee weapon attack rolls during this turn, but attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.

traits.name: Brutal Critical
traits.description: Kroeger rolls two additional weapon damage dice when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.

traits.name: Siege Breaker
traits.description: Kroeger deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Kroeger makes two attacks with his Beast Slayer Greatsword. [Or Currently Equipped Weapon].

actions.name: Beast Slayer
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit (+14 while Raging), reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d20 + 7) slashing damage, or 20 (2d20 + 10) slashing damage while Raging.

actions.name: Basalt Anvil-Slam
actions.description: (Recharge 5-6): Kroeger swings his massive blade in a wide, horizontal 10-foot arc. Each creature within 10 feet of him must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (6d6 + 7) slashing damage and is knocked Prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

reactions.name: Iron Retaliation
reactions.description: When a creature within 5 feet of Kroeger hits him with a melee attack, Kroeger can use his reaction to make one melee weapon attack against that creature.

KROEGER.description: Kroeger is a massive Ashen Elf, his large size and skills as a smith make any large or massive weapon easy for him to wield. While technically a barbarian class, he lacks formal training and isn't hard locked to the class or it's features.

resistances: Cold, Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
EVELYN (SUMMONED FORM).languages: Telepathy 60 ft. (Summoner only), understands Sura-Khai and Common but rarely speaks aloud to others

traits.name: Phase Slip
traits.description: Evelyn can move through other creatures and solid objects as if they were difficult terrain. If she ends her turn inside an object, she takes 5 (1d10) force damage.

traits.name: The Weaver's Shadow
traits.description: Evelyn is completely invisible to all creatures other than summoner while she is in heavy fog, dim light, or darkness.

traits.name: Jealous Guardian
traits.description: While Evelyn is within 5 feet of the summoning player, any melee attacks targeting summoner are made with disadvantage as her shadowy limbs lash out to deflect the blows.

actions.name: Shadow-Stitch
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +[Summoners Spell Attack Modifier] to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + Summoners Proficiency Bonus) necrotic damage. If the target is currently affected by Evelyn's Hex, this attack deals an additional 1d6 necrotic damage.

actions.name: Hex
actions.description: (1/Summon). As a bonus action, Evelyn can cast the Hex spell at 1st level (no spell slot required). She maintains concentration on the spell herself (Concentration save +1). She can use her bonus action on subsequent turns to transfer the Hex to a new target.

legendary_actions.name: Unmake
legendary_actions.description: (1/Day): Break the creatures weave: [1 Target] the target must make a DC 18 CON save, on failure the target rolls (1d100) and if it surpasses the creatures total HP it dies instantly. On a successful save the target instead will take (1d100) damage.

legendary_actions.name: Darkness
legendary_actions.description: (3/DAY): EVELYN shrouds her summoner in in complete darkness. The summoners body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see them. For the duration [1 MINUTE], any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against them. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with truesight.

legendary_actions.name: Foresight
legendary_actions.description: (1/Day): You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, the target has Advantage on D20 Tests, and other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against it. The spell ends early if you cast it again.

reactions.name: The Petty Assistant: (Automatic)
reactions.description: If the summoner commands her to help a party member she will refuse. If the summoner attempts to aid a party member by casting any beneficial buff (this includes healing) the summoner must roll (1d20) and roll over a 15 base roll with no advantages or modifiers.

reactions.name: Sabotage: (Automatic)
reactions.description: When a creature or enemy targets a player other than the summoner Evelyn buffs the attackers damage dice by adding (1d4) to the final damage.

EVELYN (SUMMONED FORM).description:
Doll Form (Passive Rules)
Tethered Soul: Evelyn cannot be separated from her owner. If left behind, thrown, or stolen, she vanishes in a whisper of grey smoke and reappears in the owners pocket or pack at the start of their next turn.
The Phase Barrier: No creature other than the owner can physically touch the doll. If anyone else attempts to grab her, their hands pass through her body like cold fog.
Mortal Ward: If owner takes damage that would reduce them to 0 hit points, they can use their reaction to instantly drop to 1 hit point instead. Evelyn absorbs the blow; she takes the remaining damage, her physical doll form cracks slightly, and she cannot be summoned again until owner completes a Long Rest.
The Spool of Charges: The doll has 2 charges. Owner can expend 1 charge to cast Hex through the doll (no spell slot or concentration required from owner—Evelyn handles the spell). She regains all expended charges at dawn.

Mage Hand.description:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

You can use your action to control the hand. You can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial. You can move the hand up to 30 feet each time you use it.

The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

Spirit Of Death.hp_formula: ( + 10 for each level of the spell above 4th)

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The reaper can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 1d10 force damage for every 5 feet traveled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spirit makes a number of Reaping Scythe attacks equal to half the level of the spell (rounded down).

actions.name: Reaping Scythe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit (with advantage), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + the spell’s level necrotic damage.

actions.name: Bonus Actions
actions.description: Haunt Creature: The spirit targets a creature it can see within 10 feet of itself and begins haunting it. While the target is haunted, you and the spirit sense the direction and distance to the target if it is on the same plane of existence as you. Additionally, if the target starts its turn within 10 feet of the spirit, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the frightened condition until the start of the target’s next turn. The target remains haunted until it dies, the spirit disappears, or the spirit uses this action again.

traits.name: Ashen Acclimation
traits.description: Kael can see through heavily obscured areas caused by ash, fog, or soot out to 120 ft., and has advantage on saves against inhaled ash or smoke.

traits.name: Law of the Maul: Captain's Command
traits.description: As a bonus action, Kael issues an iron edict. One allied creature within 30 ft. that can hear him can use its reaction to make one melee weapon attack.

traits.name: Iron Grip (Slave-Hunter)
traits.description: Kael has advantage on checks to grapple. A creature grappled by him is also Restrained. Kael has advantage on attack rolls against creatures grappled by him.

traits.name: Branding Precision
traits.description: Once per turn when Kael hits with a melee weapon attack, he can apply a Brand Mark. The marked creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against Kael until the start of Kael's next turn, and has disadvantage on saving throws against his Branding Fist.

traits.name: Thermal Core
traits.description: (Recharge 5–6): At the start of each of Kael's turns, he can roll a d6; on a 5–6 his right gauntlet ignites. While active, his Branding Fist deals an extra 9 (2d8) fire damage and can stun.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Kael makes three melee attacks, in any combination of Heavy Spiked Mauler and Branding Fist.

actions.name: Heavy Spiked Mauler
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10+6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Branding Fist (Iron Hand)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8+6) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage if Thermal Core is active. If the target is grappled by Kael, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution save or be Stunned until the start of Kael's next turn.

actions.name: Ashen Bulwark Drive
actions.description: (Recharge 4–6). Kael slams his maul into the ash-choked ground. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage, being knocked prone and pushed 10 ft. away on a failure, or half damage on success.

actions.name: Iron Grip Snare - Bonus Actions
actions.description: Kael attempts to grapple a creature within 5 ft. (+10 Athletics).

actions.name: Thermal Ignition - Bonus Actions
actions.description: Kael ignites his gauntlet for 1 minute, adding fire to Branding Fist. Once used, requires short rest.

legendary_actions.name: Move (2/Round)
legendary_actions.description: Kael moves up to half his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Maul Strike (2/Round)
legendary_actions.description: Kael makes one Heavy Spiked Mauler attack.

legendary_actions.name: Command the Chain (Costs 1 Action)
legendary_actions.description: One ally Kael can see within 30 ft. can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

reactions.name: Maul Parry
reactions.description: When Kael is targeted by a melee attack he can see, he adds +4 to his AC against that attack, deflecting with the haft of his maul.

traits.name: Ashen Acclimation
traits.description: As Kael, plus immunity to ash inhalation exhaustion while in Iron-Grip.

traits.name: Aura of the Maul
traits.description: (30 ft.): Enemies that start their turn within 30 ft. of Sotha Sil must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom save or be Frightened until the end of their next turn. The aura is the Law incarnate — iron clanging, chains dragging.

traits.name: Twin Thermal Gauntlets
traits.description: Both arms are forged weapons. When active, each Branding Fist is considered a magical weapon and deals fire damage.

traits.name: Unbreakable Grip
traits.description: Sotha Sil has advantage on grapple checks. Creatures grappled by her cannot benefit from Freedom of Movement and take 10 fire damage at the start of their turn from searing gauntlets.

traits.name: War-Lord's Ledger
traits.description: As a bonus action, Sotha Sil marks one creature she can see within 60 ft. as Property. The mark lasts 1 minute. Marked creature has disadvantage on saves vs. her abilities, and she has advantage to track it across the Ashen Wastes.

traits.name: Basalt-Chitin Carapace
traits.description: hen Sotha Sil is reduced below half HP (141), trophy plates shift, granting +2 AC until end of encounter as basalt-chitin interlocks over vitals.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Sotha Sil makes four attacks: two with Executioner's Maul and two with Branding Fists (any combination left/right).

actions.name: Executioner's Maul of Iron-Grip
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft. (extended haft), one target. Hit: 20 (2d12+8) bludgeoning damage + 7 (2d6) thunder damage (concussive shockwave). Target must DC 20 Strength save or be knocked prone and pushed 15 ft.

actions.name: Branding Fist (Left/Right)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d8+8) bludgeoning + 13 (3d8) fire. Target is grappled (escape DC 21). If Thermal active, target must DC 19 Constitution save or be Stunned until start of Sotha Sil's next turn and branded — permanent dull-crimson scar visible in ash-sight.

actions.name: Cage Collapse (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Sotha Sil slams both gauntlets into the earth. Each creature in 20 ft. radius centered on self must DC 20 Constitution save or take 28 (8d6) fire + 14 (4d6) thunder, half on success, and be Restrained by spectral iron chains until end of Sotha Sil's next turn. Chains creak with ledger-names of the taken.

legendary_actions.name: Striding Dominance
legendary_actions.description: Sotha Sil moves up to half speed. Her chains drag, difficult terrain for enemies within 5 ft. until start of next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Branding Strike
legendary_actions.description: One Branding Fist attack.

legendary_actions.name: Law Proclaimed
legendary_actions.description: One creature within 30 ft. must make DC 18 Wisdom save or be Frightened until end of its next turn, or if already marked as Property, Sotha Sil re-applies Property.

legendary_actions.name: Maul Execution (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: One Executioner's Maul attack with advantage if target is grappled or restrained. On hit, if target is below 50 HP, it must DC 19 Constitution save or drop to 0 HP — the Ledger claims its due.

lair_actions.name: Cage Drop
lair_actions.description: Spectral chains erupt in 10 ft radius DC 18 DEX or Restrained.

lair_actions.name: Basalt Tremor
lair_actions.description: 20 ft line DC 18 STR or prone + 7 bludgeoning.

lair_actions.name: Soot Cloud
lair_actions.description: 20 ft radius heavily obscured until next initiative 20.

General Sotha Sil.description: Initiative 20 (loses ties). Sotha Sil can take a lair action. Only one per round.
